description.en: CP customization suite: product docs, firmware/issues, and USB upgrade/flash sub-plugins in one bundle.
description.zh: 从平定制工具集：产品资料、固件与问题、U 盘升级与线刷，一个 bundle 三个子插件。

description.en: One bundle with three independently toggleable sub-plugins: /cp-docs product documentation, /firmware firmware & issue lookup, /cpservice USB upgrade packages and full-device flashing.
description.zh: 一个 bundle、三个可独立开关的子插件：/cp-docs 产品资料、/firmware 固件与问题检索、/cpservice U 盘升级包与整机线刷。
